item.travelersbackpack.auto_drink_upgrad: Automatically drinks water and other drinks from the backpack to quench thirst
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_allow_: Allow listed drinks (use a water bottle or bucket for tank water)
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_block_: Block listed drinks (use a water bottle or bucket for tank water)
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_always: Drink whenever the thirst bar is not full
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_half_h: Drink when at least half of the drink's thirst restoration can be used
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_full_h: Drink only when all of the drink's thirst restoration can be used
